anywhere_scan.notes: Flags any destination from these airports that comes in at or under max_price, or that drops well below its own historical average (mistake-fare style deals, like Going.com). Leave "destinations" empty for true anywhere; or list specific IATA airport codes (e.g. ["MIA","CUN","LAS"]) to only watch those. Easiest way to manage this list: use the Settings page on your dashboard instead of editing this file by hand.
